fit_stage: official E8.5 and GSE230531 two E8.5 libraries only
evaluation_stage: GSM5820434 independent E9.5 study versus official E9.5; no E9.5 fit
mapping: fresh official E8.5-only 400-marker coarse classifier, C0.5,max_iter1000, sourceconfidence>=0.8; 70/30 E8.5 classifier check only
external_early_moments: equal-library mixture of conditional-positive means and variances
intercept: a=alpha*(mu_official85-b*mu_external85); evaluated diagnostically only, not used for a temporal displacement
evaluation_selection: positive count>=10 in both E9.5 sources, >=100 evaluated genes per state; label-confidence conditioning reported
gate: at least3 evaluable states; equal-state mean of median absolute log positive-SD error improves>=5% versus slope1, improves in>=two-thirds states, and beats fixed gene-permuted-slope control
failure_policy: close without target candidate; no threshold or shrinkage retuning
scope_limit: E9.5 cross-study diagnostic does not establish E14.5 or future transfer; differences are not attributed purely to platform
